comments.author: T. Constantinescu
comments.text: The DDR5 synchronization trick is the real story here. Everyone has been obsessing over raw HBM3 pin density, but routing wide channels across standard consumer traces eliminates over 60% of the board assembly bill of materials. Looking forward to cloning the Verilog suite.

comments.author: Marcus Lindqvist
comments.text: Are there any published thermal dissipation estimates for a 4-card bench rack under continuous 70B parameter inference? If ambient dissipation remains manageable in standard 4U chassis without liquid loops, university departments will flock to this immediately.

comments.author: Sara Al-Mansoor
comments.text: Excited to see the Apache 2.0 designation. Proprietary compiler stacks have suffocated academic experimentation for far too long. If anyone is assembling an LLVM backend working group, please drop a note in the public repository tracker.
